editPlan.notes: S01 SDC_Servo_PNP. Position renames: XAxisExtend->XAxisPlace (HMI_XAxis.Parameters.Positions[0]), XAxisRetract->XAxisPick (Positions[1]), ZAxisRetract->ZAxisClear (Positions[2]); ZAxisPick stays Positions[0], ZAxisPlace stays Positions[1]. Template RangeCheck index mapping was left untouched, so tune values as: X Positions[0]=Place(50), X Positions[1]=Pick(350); Z Positions[0]=Pick(75), Z Positions[1]=Place(75), Z Positions[2]=Clear(10). The X 'Reject' position from the IR is not used by any flowchart state and was NOT added - add a third X RangeCheck instance + position index if reject handling is added later. Sequence: 4 wait index -> 7 Z Pick -> 10 close gripper -> 13 Z Clear -> 16 X Place -> 19 Z Place -> 22 open gripper -> 25 Z Clear -> 28 X Pick -> 31 cycle complete. Part tracking: Attempt latched on 10->13 (gripper confirmed closed = committed to the part), Success latched on 22->25 (part released). Wait-for-index at state 4 is a WARNING (Alarm[5], Severity 1) that drives q_Pause - never a hard fault, per the prime directive. Two new waiting alarms were added for the gripper (Alarm[6] close / Alarm[7] open, 2000 ms): AlarmList[6] and AlarmList[7] are empty in the template string data and could not be written with setStringData - please type 'Waiting For Gripper To Close' / 'Waiting For Gripper To Open' into those two AlarmList elements after import. i_PartPresent / PartPresentDebounce conditioning is left in R01 but is no longer used by a transition - wire it into the state 4 rung in place of the AlwaysOff placeholder if the pick location has a part-present sensor. StaNum set to 1 / StaNumPre to 0 - verify the upstream station number.

S01 SDC_Servo_PNP - two axis servo pick and place with pneumatic gripper. Sequence: wait for index complete (4), Z to pick (7), close gripper (10), Z to clear (13), X to place (16), Z to place (19), open gripper (22), Z to clear (25), X to pick (28), cycle complete (31). X positions: Positions[0]=Place, Positions[1]=Pick. Z positions: Positions[0]=Pick, Positions[1]=Place, Positions[2]=Clear.
